snippet.title: Rural Cat Trails | Official Game Reveal Trailer (Steam via PC)
snippet.description:
Rural Cat Trails is a nostalgic action-adventure where you wander through Nanoha Town, a quiet corner of the Japanese countryside, as a beloved house cat on a mission. It's cherry blossom season, and perched atop a steep cliff above the town is Sakurana Shrine, a place close to the heart of your late Grandpa.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3922560/Rural_Cat_Trails/

Developed by Hibikai Games
